subject: Parallel · September 2026
title: September: the Server Answers *on Three Chains.*
standfirst: The monthly report for the Parallel team: what shipped, the numbers of the month, what is planned for October and the two decisions we need.
contents_intro: The summary and the decisions are the pages to read; the rest is the evidence, kept for the record. Figures are as of 30 September.

blocks.caption: Fig. 1 · The block, rendered. From the Brand Identity file.
blocks.body: Week one put the server on Base, week two on Arbitrum and Ethereum. Agents now answer from the same read-only view of the protocol: positions, rates, backing, governance. The public beta stays on 6 November; the CLI moves one week, to week six, because the Parallel team asked for a dry run of the docs first.

bullets: Base on 5 September, Arbitrum and Ethereum on 12 September; one file per chain.
Every answer states the block number and the age of the indexer; past 300 s it says so.
The Parallel team read the tool schemas cold and asked for two renames; both done.

reco: Keep the beta date; move the CLI to week six.
One week of slack on the CLI buys the docs dry run and changes nothing for the agents.
